description: This file contains the PHP class 'Download' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account'. The class provides methods for managing account download data, including retrieving individual downloads, lists of downloads, total download count, and adding download reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A model class for handling account download data, including retrieval and report logging functionalities.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific download by its ID, considering order statuses and customer ownership.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Fetches a list of downloads within specified start and limit parameters, including filtering by order status, store, and language.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total number of downloads available for the current customer, with filtering criteria similar to 'getDownloads'.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs a report of a download access, recording download ID, customer IP, country, and timestamp.
